method_contract.task: Constrain ULB properties using Bayesian framework with BH superradiance

statistical_framework.exclusion_probability: P(excl|data,mu) = fraction of posterior samples where a* > a*_crit AND tau_SR < tau_max
statistical_framework.conservative_approach: Include timescale cut (Salpeter time for stellar BHs, 1 Gyr for SMBHs)
statistical_framework.aggressive_approach: No timescale cut, just Regge trajectory condition

target_artifacts: Mass-spin plane with SR exclusion bands
